cores: 8 physical / 16 logical (SMT enabled; benchmarks run on an otherwise idle machine)
os_baseline: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, kernel 7.0.x (bare metal, not virtualized)
core_policy: OS-scheduled on an idle machine; no cgroup isolation
turbo_boost: disabled for measurement (intel_pstate/no_turbo=1); recorded per run
notes: First x86 machine on the ledger and the first carrying PMU counters — the Apple M2 entry is secondary_platform + no_pmu because macOS withholds the counters from user processes (Charter §6.4). Coffee Lake Refresh has no AVX-512, so this machine measures the scalar and AVX2 tiers only; AVX-512 remains emulation-only under Intel SDE (ADR-010) until Zen 4/5 or a Golden-Cove-class part is registered. Fills the 'Intel x86 with AVX2' slot in docs/benchmarks/hardware-coverage-plan.md. Prepared per docs/benchmarks/running.md: performance governor, turbo disabled, kernel.perf_event_paranoid lowered for perf_event_open. SMT is left enabled and recorded rather than disabled, since toggling it requires a reboot on this host; no load is placed on sibling threads during a run.
